titles.romaji: Moana to Densetsu no Umi 2 3D Short Anime
titles.native: モアナと伝説の海2 3Dショートアニメ

description:
Four promotional animations directed by Genshou Yasuda and created by his studio Xenotoon to promote the Japanese theatrical release of Disney's Moana 2 movie.

This entry includes:
1)ビヨンド ～越えてゆこう～
2) 帰ってきた、本当のわたしに
3) できるさ！ チーフ！
4) 迷え！
